snippet.title: Gameplay - The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
snippet.description:
The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2 demo is out now for Steam Next Fest!

Play therapist whilst trying to solve the murders of your predecessors and avoid succumbing to the madness...

The demo takes around 30 minutes to play (or up to an hour if you try to find *all* the responses) and is available in English with French, Italian, German and Spanish subtitles. 

Play the demo & wishlist on Steam (PC / Mac / Steam Deck):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939680/The_Infectious_Madness_of_Doctor_Dekker_2/

WISHLIST on PlayStation:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013013
